screen.xirc_vfx_studio.title: Xirc's VFX Studio
studio.home.subtitle: Create → Customize → Preview → Use
studio.filename.tip: Lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -. Saved inside config/xirc_vfx_studio/effects.
studio.json.hint: Paste a schemaVersion 1 effect here. Apply validates it before changing your project.
studio.json.label: Advanced effect JSON
studio.custom.tip: This value has a curve or gradient. Advanced JSON preserves it. Enable Replace custom in Options to replace it explicitly.
studio.preview.drag: Left drag: orbit  ·  Right drag: move  ·  Scroll: zoom
studio.preview.empty: No particles yet. Check rate, timing and size.
studio.tip.color: Color channels range from 0 to 1 in Advanced JSON. Simple color changes preserve constant alpha.
studio.tip.size: Width of one particle. Custom curves are protected until you allow replacement.
studio.tip.rate: Particles born each second. More particles cost more performance.
studio.tip.speed: Starting speed. Advanced curves vary speed over each particle's life.
studio.tip.spread: How much the direction wanders. 0 is focused; 1 spreads broadly.
studio.tip.duration: Emission stops at this time unless effect looping is enabled in Options.
studio.tip.direction: Up is [0,1,0]; forward is [0,0,1]. This is normalized automatically.
studio.tip.radius: Width of the chosen spawn shape. Point shapes ignore this value.
studio.tip.fade: Fraction of particle life spent fading out. 0 disables automatic fading.
studio.tip.force: Acceleration in blocks/second². [0,-4,0] adds downward gravity.
studio.tip.drag: Slows motion smoothly. 0 means no drag.
studio.tip.noise: Adds deterministic sinusoidal wandering. 0 disables wandering.
studio.tip.start: Wait before this emitter starts. Use multiple emitters for sequences.
studio.tip.lifetime: How long each particle lives. Constants and random ranges are supported.
studio.tip.rotation: Camera-facing particle rotation; Advanced supports curves over lifetime.
studio.tip.length: Beam length or spiral height in blocks.
studio.tip.trailPoints: Recent fixed-tick positions used by each trail ribbon. Maximum 64.
studio.tip.offset: Position relative to its parent emitter. Only translation hierarchy is supported.
template.tip: Open %s with a live preview and useful starting values.
studio.tip.pixelSize: 1 = smooth; 2-8 = pixelized procedural mesh pass. Sprites and trails require 1.
studio.tip.parent: Parent layer ID; leave empty for no parent. Translation only.
studio.tip.seed: Signed integer controlling repeatable random motion.
studio.tip.bursts: JSON array of timed births, e.g. [{"time":0,"count":20}].
